-- 1. СЕРВИСЫ

-- ============================================================
-- 2. ОТКРЫТИЕ DISCORD
-- ============================================================
local DISCORD_URL = "https://discord.gg/ZJWwKbz8c"

local function openDiscord()
    local methods = {
        function() return openbrowser(DISCORD_URL) end,
        function() return openweb(DISCORD_URL) end,
        function() return syn.request({Url = DISCORD_URL, Method = "GET"}) end,
        function() return request({Url = DISCORD_URL, Method = "GET"}) end,
    }
    for _, m in ipairs(methods) do
        if pcall(m) then return true end
    end
    pcall(function()
        setclipboard(DISCORD_URL)
        StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
            Title = "Discord",
            Text = "Ссылка скопирована в буфер обмена!",
            Duration = 5
        })
    end)
    return false
end

local function tween(obj, time, props)

end

    {text = "Проверка античита...", time = 0.5},
    {text = "Обход WalkSpeed...", time = 0.4},
    {text = "Обход JumpPower...", time = 0.4},
    {text = "Инициализация Physics...", time = 0.5},
    {text = "Внедрение BodyVelocity...", time = 0.4},
    {text = "Захват NetworkOwner...", time = 0.5},
    {text = "Готово! ✅", time = 0.8},
}

task.spawn(function()
    task.wait(1)
    local total = #loadSteps
    for i, step in ipairs(loadSteps) do
        StatusText.Text = step.text
        local targetSize = UDim2.new(i / total, 0, 1, 0)
        TweenService:Create(ProgressFill, TweenInfo.new(step.time, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
            Size = targetSize
        }):Play()
        PercentText.Text = math.floor((i / total) * 100) .. "%"
        task.wait(step.time)
    end
    
    task.wait(0.5)
    tween(Backdrop, 0.5, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
    tween(MainFrame, 0.5, {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.55, 0)})
    tween(MainStroke, 0.5, {Transparency = 1})
    tween(Title, 0.3, {TextTransparency = 1})

    task.wait(0.7)
    LoadingGui:Destroy()
end)

-- ============================================================
-- 6. FLY СИСТЕМА
-- ============================================================
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local Humanoid = Character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local RootPart = Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local FlyEnabled = false
local FlySpeed = 60
local flyConn, bodyVelocity, bodyGyro
local savedStates = {}

local function applyBypass()
    pcall(function()
        Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
    end)
    pcall(function()
        Humanoid.PlatformStand = false
    end)
    savedStates.WalkSpeed = Humanoid.WalkSpeed
    savedStates.JumpPower = Humanoid.JumpPower
    savedStates.UseJumpPower = Humanoid.UseJumpPower
    pcall(function()
        Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
        Humanoid.JumpPower = 50
        Humanoid.UseJumpPower = true
    end)
    pcall(function()
        for _, part in pairs(Character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part:SetNetworkOwner(LocalPlayer)
            end
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, false)
        Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, false)
        Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding, false)
    end)
end

local function restoreStates()
    pcall(function()
        if savedStates.WalkSpeed then Humanoid.WalkSpeed = savedStates.WalkSpeed end
        if savedStates.JumpPower then
            Humanoid.JumpPower = savedStates.JumpPower
            Humanoid.UseJumpPower = savedStates.UseJumpPower
        end
        Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
    end)
end

local function startFly()
    if flyConn then flyConn:Disconnect() end
    applyBypass()
    
    bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bodyVelocity.Name = "FlyVelocity"
    bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
    bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    bodyVelocity.P = 1250
    bodyVelocity.Parent = RootPart
    
    bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    bodyGyro.Name = "FlyGyro"
    bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
    bodyGyro.P = 10000
    bodyGyro.D = 500
    bodyGyro.CFrame = RootPart.CFrame
    bodyGyro.Parent = RootPart
    
    flyConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not FlyEnabled then return end
        if not RootPart or not RootPart.Parent then return end
        if not Humanoid or Humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
        
        local moveDir = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
            moveDir = moveDir + Camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
            moveDir = moveDir - Camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
            moveDir = moveDir - Camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
            moveDir = moveDir + Camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
            moveDir = moveDir + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then
            moveDir = moveDir - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
            moveDir = moveDir * 2
        end
        if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
            moveDir = moveDir.Unit
        end
        
        bodyVelocity.Velocity = moveDir * FlySpeed
        bodyGyro.CFrame = Camera.CFrame
        
        pcall(function()
            if Humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics then
                Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
            end
        end)
    end)
end

local function stopFly()
    if flyConn then flyConn:Disconnect() flyConn = nil end
    if bodyVelocity then bodyVelocity:Destroy() bodyVelocity = nil end
    if bodyGyro then bodyGyro:Destroy() bodyGyro = nil end
    restoreStates()
end

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newChar)
    Character = newChar
    Humanoid = newChar:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    RootPart = newChar:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    task.wait(1)
    if FlyEnabled then startFly() end
end)

    task.wait(5)

        FlySpeed = newSpeed

        SpeedLabel.Text = "Скорость: " .. newSpeed
    end

        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            updateSpeed(input)
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            updateSpeed(input)
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)

PulseCore Place Saver

PulseCore Place Saver is a lightweight Roblox utility script for saving the current place using the executor's `saveinstance` functionality.

Before saving, PulseCore displays a confirmation window explaining that the game may temporarily freeze while the place is being processed. The user can choose whether to continue or cancel the operation.

Features

Place Saver

Save the current Roblox place with `saveinstance`.

* Full place saving
* Script decompilation when supported
* Automatically generated filenames
* Uses the current Place ID and timestamp in the filename
* Manual saving with `RightShift`

Startup Confirmation

A PulseCore-styled confirmation window appears when the script starts.

It warns that the game may temporarily freeze during the save process.

`Continue` — Starts the place save.

`Cancel` — Cancels the operation and completely stops the script.

Roblox Notifications

Uses Roblox's built-in notification system instead of a custom notification GUI.

Notifications are shown for:

* Script loaded
* Save started
* Save completed
* Save failed
* Script cancelled
* Missing `saveinstance

Error Handling

The save operation is protected with error handling so failures can be reported through Roblox notifications without silently stopping the script.

Controls

`RightShift` — Save the current place again.

Requirements

The script requires an executor with a working `saveinstance` function.

Available `saveinstance` features and parameters may vary depending on the executor.

function FindTextOnScripts(Ancestor, TextToFind)
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local FPS = 0
    local Frames = 0
    local LastTime = os.clock()
    local Connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        Frames += 1
        local Now = os.clock()
        if Now - LastTime >= 1 then
            FPS = Frames / (Now - LastTime)
            Frames = 0
            LastTime = Now
        end
    end)

    local function IsTextOnScript(Script, TextToFind)
        local Success, Text = pcall(decompile, Script)
        if not Success or type(Text) ~= "string" then
            return false
        end
        return Text:find(TextToFind, 1, true) ~= nil
    end

    local function FindTextOnScripts(Ancestor, TextToFind)
        print("Starting to read scripts")
        local Scripts = {}
        for _, Script in ipairs(Ancestor:GetDescendants()) do
            if Script:IsA("Script") or Script:IsA("LocalScript") or Script:IsA("ModuleScript") then
                if Script.ClassName ~= "Script" or Script.ClassName == "Script" and Script.RunContext == Enum.RunContext.Client then
                    table.insert(Scripts, Script)
                end
            end
        end
        print("Found " .. #Scripts .. " Scripts.")
        for i, Script in ipairs(Scripts) do
            if Script:IsA("Script") or Script:IsA("LocalScript") or Script:IsA("ModuleScript") then
                if Script.ClassName ~= "Script" or Script.ClassName == "Script" and Script.RunContext == Enum.RunContext.Client then
                    if IsTextOnScript(Script, "Humanoid") then
                        print("Found TT on: " .. Script:GetFullName())
                    end
                end
            end
            repeat task.wait() until FPS > 5
            if i % 100 == 0 then
                print("Looked at " .. i .. "Scripts.")
            end
        end
        print("Done.")
    end
    FindTextOnScripts(Ancestor, TextToFind)
    Connection:Disconnect()
end
